verdict.rationale: Viam's docs emphasize hardware abstraction so code is portable across different physical components/brands (viam-docs-1, viam-docs-19), but there is no evidence of an actual simulation environment (e.g., a virtual robot, physics simulator, or sim-mode) that would let engineers run the same code against a simulated machine before deploying to real hardware. Web-based test panels (viam-docs-6) operate on real connected hardware, not a simulator.
